name: sa_ped
description: GTA San Andreas pedestrian skeleton (RpHAnim bone IDs) -> humanoid16. Bones not listed (fingers, toes, clavicles, jaw, brows, ...) follow their parent rigidly.
sources: Bone IDs are interoperability facts (as used by the plugin-sdk ePedBones enum and existing mods); the body-to-bone choice is our own. Model axes of SA peds: +Z up, +Y forward. To be verified against the in-game hierarchy in Phase 6.
